model: Unchanged original Nano model, four fixed views and postprocessing
execution: One scoped inference worker; the calling thread owns the original freshness guard. One in-flight image and one replaceable pending image. Standard library channels only.
source_clock: Original acquisition offsets, without renewal. Process every released source in order before admitting a completed result or dispatching pending work.
barriers: Every missing/failed source is delivered to the guard and discards only the pending image. Active inference is drained; its original acquisition must pass the unchanged guard after completion.
completion: Worker errors deliver a failed event. Every admitted result is followed by an observed post-tracking tick. Monitor beyond the final source/result until its accepted acquisition expires.
limits: Offline bounded replay, not a hard real-time scheduler. OS stalls may delay checks. Cannot cancel a hung native forward or control a vehicle. Ten-second trace budget; no partial successful output on fatal clock/channel/budget errors.
